# Golden: daemon extract_command() applied to every active fixture line

LINE: boot echo "Boot marker written"; : --notify
CMD: echo "Boot marker written"

LINE: boot sh; : --interactive
CMD: sh

LINE: boot pkg update && pkg upgrade -y; : --termux
CMD: pkg update && pkg upgrade -y

LINE: 08:30 logcat -c; : --notify-end --msg="Logs cleared"
CMD: logcat -c

LINE: 0830 echo "Daily ping" >> /sdcard/ping.log
CMD: echo "Daily ping" >> /sdcard/ping.log

LINE: weekly:1:0800 echo "Monday task"; : --notify-start
CMD: echo "Monday task"

LINE: nweekly:2:5:1400 echo "Biweekly Friday task"
CMD: echo "Biweekly Friday task"

LINE: monthly:01:0000 echo "Month start"; : --notify
CMD: echo "Month start"

LINE: nmonthly:3:15:1200 echo "Quarterly task"; : --msg="Quarterly done"
CMD: echo "Quarterly task"

LINE: yearly:12:25:0800 echo "Merry Christmas"; : --delete --notify
CMD: echo "Merry Christmas"

LINE: 14:30 echo "Run me now"; : --run-once-now --notify
CMD: echo "Run me now"

LINE: 08:00 echo "One-shot delete me"; : --delete
CMD: echo "One-shot delete me"

LINE: 10:00 echo "Interactive era"; : --interactive
CMD: echo "Interactive era"

LINE: boot /sdcard/Documents/su-scheduler/backup.sh; : --delete
CMD: /sdcard/Documents/su-scheduler/backup.sh

LINE: 09:15 python <<EOF; : --termux --notify
CMD: python <<EOF

LINE: print("hello from python")
CMD: from python")

LINE: EOF
CMD: EOF

CMD: sh <<EOF
